name: Izayoi
source:
Kusanagi Yorokuya comes from an ancient family. He transfers to another school to locate spiritual abnormality that broke through the barrier and also to investigate night school "seven wonders".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
草薙十六夜出身于古老家族。为了寻找突破结界的灵异异象，并调查夜校的“七大不可思议”，他转学至另一所学校。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
